title: MEASURING TOOLS FOR v AND a: sigmoid, uncanny valley, Dunning–Kruger

the_thesis.physics: position → velocity (1st deriv) → acceleration (2nd) → jerk (3rd). acceleration predicts.
the_thesis.sigmoid: σ(x) measures maturity/health. σ'(x)=σ(1-σ) is MAX at inflection — quiet turn, fastest change. velocity of becoming.
the_thesis.uncanny_valley: UV(x)=σ(x)-valley(x≈0.85). comfort dips where fidelity almost-works. uncanny_depth = drag on usable acceleration.
the_thesis.dunning_kruger: confidence vs competence. dk_gap>0 overconfident (mount stupid) — claimed velocity exceeds true competence → FAKE accel. dk_gap<0 underconfident — real capacity unused.
the_thesis.combined: true_accel ≈ σ'(x)·(1-uncanny_depth) - λ·|dk_gap|. sort and bounce using THIS energy, not raw count.

zones_on_x.0.0-0.2: absent / mount stupid risk if confident
zones_on_x.0.2-0.4: emerging / valley of despair if learning
zones_on_x.0.8-0.9: UNCANNY — do not polish; push through or stay honest
